Include all four time-in-force values in the results and average, assigning zero to values without matched records.
readings: For each time in force, using risk/margin records matched to their orders (`riskandmargin.ordervault` = `orders.recordvault`; unmatched dropped), show the time in force, its risk/margin count, that count's share of the overall total, and how far the share is from the average share across time-in-force values. No rounding. Include only time-in-force values with matched risk/margin records in the results and average.

For each time in force, using risk/margin records matched to their orders (`riskandmargin.ordervault` = `orders.recordvault`; unmatched dropped), show the time in force, its risk/margin count, that count's share of the overall total, and how far the share is from the average share across time-in-force values. No rounding. Include all four time-in-force values in the results and average, assigning zero to values without matched records.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count
    FROM riskandmargin AS r
    JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
    WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        timespan,
        risk_margin_count,
        1.0 * risk_margin_count / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM counts
)
SELECT
    timespan,
    risk_margin_count,
    share,
    ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS distance_from_average_share
FROM shares;

WITH time_in_force(value) AS (
  VALUES ('IOC'), ('GTC'), ('GTD'), ('FOK')
),
counts AS (
  SELECT t.value AS timespan, COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) AS risk_margin_count
  FROM time_in_force AS t
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.timespan = t.value
  LEFT JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY t.value
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    timespan,
    risk_margin_count,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () = 0 THEN 0.0
      ELSE 1.0 * risk_margin_count / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER ()
    END AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT
  timespan,
  risk_margin_count,
  share,
  ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS distance_from_average_share
FROM shares
